items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah
items.claim: The LORD called Bezaleel by name
items.object: Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah

items.quote: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship
items.claim: The LORD filled Bezaleel with the spirit of God and endowed him with various forms of wisdom and knowledge

items.quote: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass
items.claim: Bezaleel is capable of devising cunning works and working with gold, silver, and brass
items.object: gold, and in silver, and in brass

items.quote: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship
items.claim: Bezaleel is skilled in cutting stones, setting them, and carving timber
